intent: Record as reviewed the suggestion request, digest, apply and judging rules the eval Context enforces and tests.
observable_outcome: get-context eval lists the rules as reviewed, each proven by its test.

acceptance_criteria.statement: At most ten suggestions are stored for one evaluation; the rest are counted as dropped over the cap.
When the verdict yields no citable evidence, suggestions are not requested and nothing is paid.
A quote shorter than twelve characters cannot be matched to a verified excerpt as suggestion evidence.
Passed criteria are left out of the suggestion digest, so their evidence cannot be cited for an improvement.
Informational findings are left out of the suggestion digest, so a disclosure cannot be quoted as proof of a problem.
An apply request that names the same suggestion twice applies it once.
Applying a suggestion that is not accepted is refused, naming it, and no version is built.
A suggestion that belongs to another evaluation is not found when applied through this one.
Suggestions apply only under the skill their evaluation ran; another skill's id is not found.
When two selected suggestions target the same file, both are refused rather than the last one winning.
When every selected suggestion is blocked, the apply returns the rejections and builds no version.
When applying suggestions rebuilds an existing version, the suggestions are recorded against that version.
A passed criterion is recorded as undetermined when the trace is incomplete, the input was cut, or the evidence rests on a trimmed source.
The judge is sent at most twenty criteria, and a longer list is marked as cut so no pass rests on it.
